Calls for expression of interest

  1. Home
  2. About Us
  3. Funding & Tenders
  4. Calls For Expression of Interest

EFCA’s calls for expressions of interest are a means to establish a list of external experts. The external experts selected and contracted by EFCA will be assigned particular tasks – required to be performed by an external expert – relating to the field of the call for expressions of interest in question.

Calls for expression of interest
Number Name and documents Deadline for applications Validity of list
EFCA/2026/CEI/0007 Call for expression of interest with a view to drawing up lists of experts to assist in operational coordination and assistance in projects on Capacity building and coastguard related functions and Fisheries data and control technologies 10/04/2031 Thu, 10/07/2031 - 12:00
EFCA/2021/CEI/01 EXPIRED Call for expression of interest with a view to drawing up lists of experts to assist in operational coordination and assistance in projects on Capacity building and coastguard related functions and Fisheries data and control technologies 21/03/2026 Sun, 21/06/2026 - 12:00
EFCA/CEI/2018/01 EXPIRED Call for expressions of interest with a view to drawing up lists of experts to assist in operational coordination activities and assistance in projects on fisheries data analysis, risk assessment and compliance evaluation. 22/07/2023 Sun, 22/10/2023 - 12:00
EFCA/2016/CEI/01 EXPIRED Call for expression of interest with a view to compiling a list of experts to support EFCA activities in relation to capacity building and coastguard related functions 16/04/2021 Fri, 16/07/2021 - 12:00
